integrity: The global translation minimization is reduced by rotational averaging and the planar Brunn-Minkowski inequality. The closed form then follows from disjoint circular caps because the equal-area disk radius lies strictly between the inradius and circumradius. The asymptotic constants are Taylor consequences of the exact formula; numerical integration is used only as a replay check.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved for regular planar polygons and equal-area Euclidean disks. It does not classify every possible translating disk that could tie the centered optimizer, nor does it treat arbitrary cyclic or equiangular polygons.
title: Exact Fraenkel asymmetry of regular polygons
